% !tp-example Basic usage
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpCallout[variant=info,heading=Information]{ The workshop starts at 9:00. }
\end{document}

% !tp-example Javascript API
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcScript[type=module]|
import "/components/callout/callout.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-callout");
element1.setAttribute("variant", "info");
element1.setAttribute("heading", "Information");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  The workshop starts at 9:00.\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
|
\end{document}

% !tp-example Dismissible notice
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpCallout[variant=success,heading=Saved,closable]{Your changes have been saved.}
\end{document}

% !tp-example Outlined warning
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
\wcTpCallout[variant=warning,heading=Before leaving,outlined]{Save your work before closing this page.}
\end{document}
